input.answer: Gasoline prices in Canada (CPI, Gasoline, 2002=100) rose 27.8% from September 2025 to September 2026. The index went from 209.4 to 267.6. Calculation: (267.6 − 209.4) / 209.4 × 100 = 58.2 / 209.4 × 100 ≈ 27.8%. I read "prices at the pump" as the CPI gasoline index, not seasonally adjusted.

answer_values.description: Gasoline CPI, Canada, percent change Sep 2025 to Sep 2026 (209.4 to 267.6)
